# Ceru

> Ceru is a mobile app for splitting group expenses: trips, dinners, shared homes, events and projects. You add an expense by voice, by a photo of the receipt, or by hand, and the app works out who owes whom. It has no ads. It is on the App Store for iPhone; Android is in closed testing.

Ceru was previously developed under the working name SplitAI. It is made by Forma (https://forma-ltd.com/).

## What it does

- Voice input: say "Dinner 80 euros, split 4 ways" and the amount, currency, people and category are filled in.
- Receipt scanning: photograph a receipt and assign each line to the people who had it; the tip is split in proportion.
- Manual entry: works fully offline and syncs when the connection is back.
- Splits: equally, by exact amounts, by shares, or by receipt line.
- Balances: one screen shows who owes whom; debt simplification reduces the number of payments.
- Reminders: push reminders about open debts, so nobody has to ask in person.
- Group types: trip, roommates, couple and family, event, project.
- Guests: add friends by name without making them install the app; if they join later by link they keep their history.
- 154 currencies with daily exchange rates.
- 8 interface languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew (right to left), Spanish, German, Kazakh, Arabic (right to left).
- Import from Splitwise: export a group from Splitwise as a spreadsheet and pick that file when creating a group in Ceru.
- Activity feed and comments on expenses.

## Price

- Free: groups, members, manual expenses, all currencies, guests, debt reminders, offline use. No ads. AI input is free up to 5 voice entries and 3 receipt scans a month.
- Ceru Pro: $3.99 a month or $29.99 a year in the US App Store (prices may differ by country). Unlimited voice input and receipt scanning, analytics, group budgets with alerts, export to PDF and Excel.

## Limits worth knowing

- Voice input and receipt scanning need an internet connection, because the audio or photo is processed by AI services.
- There is no public Android release yet. Android is in closed testing; write to av.studio.devs@gmail.com for a build.
- Ceru records debts and settlements; it does not move money between people.

## Privacy

- No ads, and data is not sold.
- Expenses are visible only to the members of the group.
- An account and its data can be deleted: https://ceruapp.com/delete-account.html
